$\nu_3/B \approx 15.7 \implies \nu_3 \approx 15.7 \times 1,045 = 16,406 \text{ cm}^{-1}$

These calculated values are in excellent agreement with the observed absorption bands ($3,600$, $7,870$, and $16,410 \text{ cm}^{-1}$).
